landing.hero_desc: ClearVoice provides a robust, API-first platform to generate, validate, and deliver tax-compliant electronic invoices worldwide.
landing.features_title: Everything you need for global billing
landing.features_desc: A unified platform that handles the complexities of tax compliance, invoice delivery, and reporting.
landing.feat1_desc: Automatically format and deliver invoices according to local tax authority regulations (currently a simulated clearance service).
landing.feat2_desc: Direct integration with government clearance portals for immediate invoice validation and approval.
landing.feat3_desc: Track invoice statuses in real-time, monitor clearance rates, and analyze your financial volume.
landing.api_desc: ClearVoice was built API-first. Our RESTful endpoints, comprehensive webhooks, and predictable schemas make it easy to embed compliant invoicing directly into your ERP or billing system.
landing.sec_desc: We protect your financial data with industry-leading security practices, rigorous compliance standards, and robust access controls.
landing.cta_desc: Join forward-thinking companies using ClearVoice to automate their tax compliance and e-invoicing operations globally.
landing.footer_desc: The complete toolkit for global electronic invoicing, tax compliance, and automated document delivery.
